name: Zhuzhou Hongda Electronics Corp.,Ltd.
summary: Zhuzhou Hongda Electronics Corp.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and servicing of electronic components and circuit modules in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through HTC Branch and Xiangyi Branch segments. The company offers power modules and IF converters; microstrip circulator isolators comprising microstrip isolators and circulators, conventional microstrip circulator isolators, shielded microstrip circulator assemblies, tri-junction microstrip circulator assemblies, ultra-wideband microstrip circulators/isolators, and surface-mount microstrip circulators/isolators; tantalum capacitors consist…
